summary: Iter-23 — Tested the 3 sprint features: BottomNav, /instalar page, Landing hero gradient mobile redesign. 10/11 expected outcomes pass. Only failure is BottomNav not appearing on /messages — root cause is a pre-existing crash inside the Messages component (TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined reading 'charAt' inside Array.map), which unmounts the whole React tree including BottomNav. The BottomNav feature itself is implemented correctly. /instalar (and /install alias) render perfectly with QR + 3 benefit cards + back link + footer install link. Landing hero gradient is now the new black->teal on mobile (393x852) and remains the original #063154 deep-teal on desktop (1440x900). No horizontal overflow on /instalar at 390x844.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'charAt') in Array.map inside <Messages>. Crashes the route and unmounts BottomNav. Likely a conversation/user field is undefined when rendering the list (e.g. a participant name initial).

integration_issues.issue: BottomNav disappears on /messages because the Messages page crashes (root cause above). Once Messages is fixed, BottomNav will render correctly since the same component works on /, /search, /dashboard, /profile.

bottomnav.active_label_color_inline_style: #025F67 (set via inline style on label span; verified the indicator span exists on /dashboard with bg #025F67)
bottomnav.note_on_color_test: Initial getComputedStyle on span:last-child returned rgb(6,49,84) because the indicator span (last child when active) has no explicit color — it inherits from a parent. The active label span has the correct #025F67 color inline. Visually no concern.

landing_hero.desktop_1440_gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(6,49,84) 0%, rgb(10,77,94) 50%, rgb(2,95,103) 100%) — DESKTOP UNCHANGED ✓

console_errors_observed: Multiple /api 401 responses on anonymous landing — expected (auth probe).
On /messages (pre-existing): pageerror TypeError ... 'charAt' inside <Messages> Array.map. Followed by 500 from a downstream API.
No console errors on /instalar or / (landing) when logged out.
action_items: Fix <Messages> component: guard against undefined fields in Array.map before calling .charAt (likely a participant.name or similar). Add an ErrorBoundary around routes so a single page crash doesn't unmount the BottomNav / global chrome.
Pre-existing 500s on some /api endpoints after login (not in this sprint scope) — worth a follow-up.
critical_code_review_comments: BottomNav.jsx is clean and well-commented. The body.has-bottom-nav toggle effect uses navVisible derived from user+path+keyboardOpen, but the early return below (if !user) means the component unmounts on logout and the cleanup function in the effect runs — good. However, when Messages crashes, BottomNav unmounts without graceful cleanup; an app-level ErrorBoundary would protect the global chrome.
Install.jsx duplicates copy strings inline for EN/ES. Consider moving to I18nContext for maintainability — non-blocking.
Footer install link uses an animated pulsing dot which is good for attention, but no aria-label distinguishing it from the other links — minor a11y nit.

success_rate.frontend: 91% (10/11 sprint checks pass; /messages BottomNav failure is caused by unrelated pre-existing crash)
